name: print-social-digital-marketing-expert-post-white-and-burnt-orange
title: 'Digital Marketing Expert' post with a smiling woman and burnt-orange corner shapes
whatItIs: A square post on a white plaster-textured background with a large black 'Digital Marketing Expert' headline, a dark 'Join us' pill, a smiling woman in a patterned headwrap and red top, and burnt-orange angled blocks at the top-right and bottom-left holding contact info.
whatItMeans: Warm and friendly; orange blocks echo her headwrap for a coordinated look.
techniques: Pick the accent colour from the subject's clothing.
Use angled blocks in opposite corners for balance.
Add a subtle wall texture behind white areas.

vocabulary.definition: Taking an accent colour from within the photo.
